jobs.title: Security Officer - Unarmed Security
jobs.description:
Security Officer – Unarmed Security

ProTex Security Services, LLC

ProTex Security Services is seeking dependable, professional, and service-oriented Unarmed Security Officers to join our growing team.

Our Security Officers play an important role in protecting our clients’ employees, visitors, facilities, and assets. This position is ideal for individuals who are observant, dependable, professional, and comfortable working independently while providing excellent customer service.

Responsibilities

As a Security Officer, your responsibilities may include:

  • Monitor and patrol assigned areas to help maintain a safe and secure environment
  • Conduct routine foot and/or vehicle patrols
  • Monitor entrances, exits, gates, and other access points
  • Verify employee, visitor, vendor, and contractor access as required
  • Observe and report suspicious activity, safety concerns, and security incidents
  • Respond appropriately to alarms, emergencies, and unusual situations
  • Complete accurate daily activity reports and incident reports
  • Follow site-specific post orders, policies, and security procedures
  • Assist employees, visitors, and contractors in a professional and courteous manner
  • Communicate security concerns promptly to supervisors and client representatives
  • Maintain a professional appearance and demeanor while on duty
  • Perform other security-related duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • High school diploma or equivalent preferred
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States
  • Ability to pass applicable background screening requirements
  • Ability to obtain and maintain any required state security license or registration
  • Reliable transportation and dependable attendance
  • Strong communication and customer-service skills
  • Ability to remain alert and professional throughout the assigned shift
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
  • Basic ability to use a smartphone, computer, or electronic reporting system
  • Security, military, law enforcement, customer service, hospitality, or similar experience is a plus, but security experience is not required for all positions

What We Look For

At ProTex, we look for Security Officers who demonstrate:

Integrity — Doing the right thing and maintaining the trust placed in you by our clients and team.

Awareness — Remaining attentive to your surroundings and identifying potential security or safety concerns before they become larger problems.

Professionalism — Treating employees, visitors, clients, and fellow team members with respect while representing ProTex professionally.

Dependability — Showing up prepared, on time, and ready to perform the responsibilities of the position.

What ProTex Offers

  • Competitive pay
  • Full-time and part-time opportunities
  • Multiple shift opportunities depending on location
  • Training and professional development
  • Opportunities for advancement into supervisory and management positions
  • A professional, team-oriented work environment
  • Additional benefits may be available depending on position, location, and eligibility

Join the ProTex Team

ProTex Security Services is committed to providing professional, dependable security services while creating opportunities for employees to build meaningful careers in the security industry.

Whether you already have security experience or are looking to begin a career in the industry, we encourage qualified candidates to apply.

Apply today to be considered for a Security Officer position with ProTex Security Services.

Pay: From $17.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • Health insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
• Please note this position is not remote and RJW will not be providing relocation assistance.**

Schedule/Shift: Monday - Friday (1st Shift) / 6:30 AM - 3:30 PM (Hours subject to change based on business needs)

Salary: $65-$70k annual

Location: 275 W Laraway Rd, Joliet, IL 60436 (W16)

We are logistics experts who store and ship everyday products for over 1,000 customers to major retailers we all shop at.

We’ve more than doubled our warehouse network nationwide over the last two years. In the Chicago area alone we have 14 active warehouses across Woodridge, Bolingbrook, Romeoville, Lockport and Joliet with two startups in Plainfield ramping up. That means team members have real opportunities to grow with us.

We are driven by service excellence, continuous improvement and an ownership mindset. For our team members, that creates an environment where hard work matters, new ideas are valued and every person has the opportunity to help shape our future while sharing in the success we build together.

Make an Impact in Our Warehouse Operations

As a Warehouse Supervisor at RJW, you lead a team that keeps our customers’ products moving safely, accurately and on time. You set the tone on the floor, bringing a strong focus on safety, quality and productivity while developing the associates who make it all happen.

What You Will Do

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of warehouse associates to meet or exceed customer expectations.
  • Plan, prioritize and assign daily work to align labor and equipment with volume, service commitments and customer requirements.
  • Ensure all orders are picked, staged, loaded and shipped accurately, on time and in compliance with customer specifications and RJW standards.
  • Oversee accurate, timely documentation and system transactions (BOLs, manifests, receipts, adjustments and other required paperwork).
  • Champion a strong safety and quality culture on the dock and in the warehouse, driving continuous improvement.
  • Partner with Customer Solutions/Customer Service and other supervisors to resolve issues, ensure smooth shift handoffs and deliver a consistent experience for associates and customers.

What You Bring

  • Minimum of 3+ years of previous warehouse supervisory/managerial experience in a fast-paced distribution or logistics environment.
  • Proven ability to lead and motivate a diverse team while holding high standards for safety, accuracy, productivity and attendance.
  • Experience planning labor and work assignments in a high-volume, deadline-driven operation.
  • Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS); strong overall computer and data entry skills.
  • Clear and confident communication skills - able to set expectations, give feedback and partner effectively with internal teams and external partners.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and a “roll up your sleeves” approach to supporting the operation.

Rewards

  • $65,000 to $70,000 annual salary.
  • All team members - not just a select few - are given shares in the company at no cost through our MyShare program. You will have a direct stake in our success.
  • Wide ranging benefits including health, dental and vision plans, life and disability insurances, retirement savings plan, PTO/paid holidays and weekly pay.
  • Career growth opportunities across our Chicago-area warehouse network.

Benefits

  • Company MyShare program
  • 401(k) matching
  • Medical/Dental/Vision insurance
  • Employee discount
  • Flexible spending account
  • Health savings account
  • Paid time off
  • Sick Days
  • Long-term Disability Insurance
  • Short-term Disability Insurance
  • Accidental Insurance
  • Critical Illness Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

jobs.title: Security Guard, Substitute
jobs.description:
Job Description

Wage - $20.77 an hour

Schedule – As needed

MTC is proud to operate the Joliet Job Corps Center in Joliet, IL where our staff provide quality services to our local youth. We value our professional and caring employees who are dedicated to improving people’s lives and we want YOU to join our team!

What you will be doing: Responsible for providing security coverage at campus access gate, performing patrol duties in assigned areas to ensure positive group relations and activities, to protect life and property, in compliance with government and management directives.

Essential Functions

  • Follow company security procedures on all persons and vehicles entering and exiting the campus
  • Advise students and provide guidance for positive attitude and behavior in on center activities
  • Patrol and monitor center grounds and the surrounding vicinities as required ensuring safety and proper behavior of students; resolving potential or occurring problems
  • Protect and secure buildings, center vehicles and property by checking doors, windows, lights, electrical appliances, equipment, locks and emergency equipment; maintain log of findings and corrective action taken; control security vehicle assignments and use
  • Assist in emergency evacuation, control and accountability of students and staff; respond to fire alarms; take necessary steps to report fires; reset fire alarm equipment
  • Issue visitor badges and parking permits; issue staff and student keys and badges; maintain related records
  • Distribute petty cash, maintain accountability logs and receipts, and audit each shift
  • Assist staff and law enforcement personnel in controlling disturbances; conduct investigation of crimes and unauthorized activities as assigned
  • Review student problems with counselors and student personnel officer
  • Assume supervisory responsibility of all safety and security activities when assigned
  • Perform administrative functions such as logs, incident reports and accident documentation; act as center dispatcher as assigned
  • When directed to do so, overtime is expected
  • Regular and predictable attendance is required
  • Participate in student employability programs and activities
  • Support and promote center zero tolerance policies
  • Provide positive, quality customer services to students, staff and other center customers
  • Promote the development of Career Success Standards by modeling appropriate behaviors, mentoring students where necessary and monitoring both positive and negative behaviors through interventions
  • Maintain accountability of students and property; adhere to safety practices
  • Assist, support and communicate with community life departments to ensure high level of service.

Education & Experience

  • High school diploma or equivalent and one year experience working with youth preferred
  • Security related experience is desired
  • Computer proficiency required
  • Valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record

Management & Training Corporation (MTC) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, disabled status, veteran status, genetic information, national origin, or any other category protected by federal law. MTC participates in E-Verify. We strive to provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities, including disabled veterans, in our job application and hiring process. If you are interested in employment opportunities with Management & Training Corporation and need assistance, please contact our staffing department through customersupport@mtctrains.com or 801-693-2888.

jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Job Description

As a Security Officer Compliance Review in Joliet, IL, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Logistics & Distribution, and more. Join Allied Universal at a dynamic logistics and distribution location, where you will monitor assigned areas, conduct routine patrols, and maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents. You will support a welcoming environment through exceptional customer service, clear communication, and teamwork. Bring integrity, reliability, and an agile mindset to a role where your contributions help keep operations running smoothly.

Position Type: Full Time

 Pay Rate: $18.39 / Hour

Job Schedule

DayTimeMon02:00 PM - 10:00 PMTue02:00 PM - 10:00 PMWed02:00 PM - 10:00 PMSat06:00 AM - 02:00 PMSun06:00 AM - 02:00 PM

What You'll Do

  • Provide customer service to clients by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities.
  • Respond to incidents and critical situations in a calm, problem-solving manner, communicating with site contacts and emergency services as needed.
  • Conduct regular and random patrols of distribution facilities, loading areas, parking areas, offices, and perimeter locations to help deter unauthorized activity.
  • Monitor access points, verify visitor and contractor authorization, and maintain accurate visitor and incident documentation.
  • Observe freight movement and facility activity, report unusual conditions or security-related concerns, and follow established escalation procedures.

Minimum Requirements

  • Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.
  • Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.
  • Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.
  • As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.
  • A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

  • Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.
  • Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.
  • Financial and Health Benefits: Enjoy access to a retirement savings plan, plus medical, dental, vision, basic life and AD&D, and disability insurance.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.
